headline: Ross comps accelerated to 7% on traffic and bigger baskets, beating estimates; full-year outlook raised.
guidance_note: Q4 comp raised to +3-4%, EPS $1.77-1.85; FY25 EPS raised to $6.38-6.46.
key_messages: Comp +7%, accelerating from Q2, driven by both more transactions and a larger average basket.
Conroy credited 'compelling brand name values' and a new marketing campaign for higher traffic.
Tariffs cost ~$0.05/share; operating margin 11.6%, down 35 bps on tariff-related costs.
Q3 benefited from favorable packaway-related expense timing that reverses (~$0.03/share) in Q4.

consumer.pricing: Tariff-related costs weighed ~$0.05/share and 35 bps of margin.
consumer.quote: We are pleased with our third quarter sales results, which accelerated from the prior quarter

macro_read: Accelerating comps into holiday 2025 showed shoppers leaning into branded bargains even as tariffs squeezed retailer margins.
